problem_size.n: <int> Total number of nodes (locations) in the network.
problem_size.m: <int> Number of clusters that partition all nodes.
problem_size.num_edges: <int> Total number of undirected edges connecting pairs of nodes.

nodes.cluster: <int> Cluster to which this node belongs.

clusters.node_ids: <list[int], length varies> Nodes that belong to this cluster.
clusters.size: <int> Number of nodes in this cluster.

distance_matrix_upper_triangular.values: <list[int], length n*(n-1)/2> Pairwise Euclidean travel costs between all node pairs, stored as a flat upper-triangular matrix in row-major order.
